summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings filed a Form 6-K on September 30, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing the voluntary delisting of its ordinary shares from the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. Trading on the TASE ends January 1, 2027, with formal delisting on January 4, 2027. The ADSs, each representing 90 ordinary shares, continue on Nasdaq under FRSX. No price, stake, premium, or fee terms were disclosed. Management cited reduced dual-listing costs and a pivot toward European data-center plans. Watch ADS conversion flows, TASE liquidity migration, and any Nasdaq listing-compliance or ADR-ratio adjustments.
